newsitem.title: CHINA: Jianshe first-half net slumps 51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jianshe first-half net slumps 51 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures):
Earnings per share 0.05 yuan vs 0.12 yuan
Net assets per share 2.56 yuan vs 2.44 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen North Jianshe Motorcycle Co Ltd .
Note: The unaudited results, compiled under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits, were published in a report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 23.47 million yuan for the first half of 1997, compared with 57.06 million yuan in the year-ago period, it said.
Trading in Jianshe's B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning pending the announcement, and would resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
